title: You Could Fit In Its Mouth. You'd Never Fit Down Its Throat.

scenes.notes: You'd fit inside a blue whale's mouth. It still couldn't swallow you.

scenes.notes: This is the heaviest animal ever measured. Up to thirty metres long. That's two and a half city buses, parked nose to tail. Lying beside it, you'd cover a sixteenth.
It can weigh close to two hundred tonnes. Heavier than the biggest dinosaurs ever found.
The tongue alone weighs about as much as an elephant. That's about forty of you.

scenes.notes: The heart is the size of a golf cart, and outweighs two of you. On a deep dive, it can slow to just two beats a minute.

scenes.notes: Its call is louder than a jet engine, and it could reach you hundreds of kilometres away.
To eat, it charges into a cloud of krill and takes one gulp of water bigger than its own body.
So what happens to you, floating right in the middle of that cloud?

scenes.notes: It eats up to forty million krill a day, and every one is tiny. Its throat only opens about as wide as a beach ball. Anything bigger just gets pushed back out.

scenes.notes: The real danger isn't being eaten. It's being in the way when two hundred tonnes decides to turn, and a tail seven metres wide sweeps past.

scenes.notes: Room for you in its mouth. No room down its throat. And it would never even notice you.
